notes.title: Release MEMOLOGY: ITALIAN BRAINROT
notes.notes: [p]Most likely, everyone has already heard about Brainrot? Can you guess the names of each Italian animal? Test your knowledge about them in the new part of Memology: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724870/MEMOLOGIYA_ITALYANSKIE_ZHIVOTNYE/"]MEMOLOGY: ITALIAN BRAINROT![/url][/p][p]Recently, there have been many games dedicated to Italian brainrot. But have you seen many really well-developed games on this topic? In this version of the game, the music is made by AI tools. The voice acting of AI characters has also been worked out, which has come to life due to her in the already familiar quiz format.[/p][p]Rather, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724870/MEMOLOGIYA_ITALYANSKIE_ZHIVOTNYE/"]purchase a new memology with a 40% discount in honor of its release[/url].[/p]

notes.title: The official release of the game and the announcement of something interesting!
notes.notes:
Dear fans of memological sciences, today our game can be called released! (including main bug fixes and refilling the base of most actual russian / CIS / post-soviet memes)

There will be updates to the first part of the game later, but for now... There comes a day when you will have to remember everything, start digging and explore even the most ancient memes…

MEMOLOGY: exam for scoofs - a new project from our publishing house is already in development and will be released very soon so that any boomer, doomer (and anyone from generations a, b, c) tried themselves on old memes!

 Find out your level of scoofism, reach heights and amaze your friends with the level of knowledge of prehistoric memes!
